ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of Amrutanjan Health Care Limited's FY2025-26 annual report submission:  Amrutanjan Health Care Limited reported strong performance in FY2025-26, achieving 11% revenue growth and 25% profit growth (before exceptional items), primarily driven by its pain management and women's hygiene segments. A material impact is the significant capital investment in a new sanitary napkin manufacturing plant, aimed at bolstering future growth in the women's hygiene category, alongside continued portfolio diversification and digital distribution expansion. The key red flag is the ongoing "severe regulatory hurdles" negatively impacting the electrolyte drink category, which has been a setback to its growth for the past three years.
